pathophysiology.summary: Women with uncomplicated pregnancies should be given every opportunity to go into spontaneous labour; induction can be offered from 41+0 weeks. The Bishop score guides the method: dinoprostone or low-dose oral misoprostol for a score of 6 or less; amniotomy with intravenous oxytocin for a score above 6. Mechanical methods are less likely to cause uterine hyperstimulation than pharmacological methods. Dinoprostone and misoprostol are contraindicated by their marketing authorisations for induction in women with a uterine scar.

redFlags: Abnormal fetal heart rate or excessive contractions after dinoprostone or misoprostol.
Suspected uterine rupture needs an immediate category 1 caesarean birth.
precipitants: Post-term pregnancy; preterm prelabour rupture of membranes; other maternal or fetal indications.

differentials.condition: Indication for planned caesarean birth instead
differentials.distinguishingFeatures: Fetal growth restriction with fetal compromise: caesarean birth, not induction.

ruleIn.clinicalRationale: A normal pattern must be confirmed before induction.
Timing is based on the dating scan.

ruleIn.testName: Check for low-lying placenta before sweeping or induction
ruleIn.clinicalRationale: NICE advises checking before sweeping or induction.

ruleIn.testName: Group B streptococcus result in preterm prelabour rupture of membranes
ruleIn.targetCondition: Immediate induction or caesarean after 34+0 weeks
ruleIn.clinicalRationale: Positive result after 34+0 weeks: offer immediate induction or caesarean birth.

ruleOut.clinicalRationale: Dinoprostone and misoprostol are contraindicated by marketing authorisation in women with a uterine scar.

clinicalManagement.title: Counsel and offer
actions: Give every opportunity for spontaneous labour; discuss induction from 41+0 weeks and membrane sweeping after 39+0 weeks.

clinicalManagement.title: Assess readiness
actions: Record the Bishop score; confirm normal cardiotocography; check for low-lying placenta.

clinicalManagement.title: Choose method
actions: Bishop score 6 or less: dinoprostone (tablet, gel or controlled-release system) or oral misoprostol 25 micrograms; mechanical method for outpatient or lower hyperstimulation risk.
Bishop score above 6: amniotomy with intravenous oxytocin.

clinicalManagement.title: Monitor
actions: Assess fetal wellbeing with cardiotocography once contractions begin; reassess Bishop score at intervals.

clinicalManagement.title: Act on hyperstimulation
clinicalManagement.timeframe: If excessive contractions or abnormal heart rate
actions: Restart continuous monitoring, give no further doses, remove vaginal products if possible and consider tocolysis.

regimens.indication: Induction of labour with Bishop score 6 or less

monitoring: Cardiotocography once contractions begin; uterine activity.
contraindications: Abnormal fetal heart rate or excessive contractions: give no further doses.

regimens.frequency: Single dose, followed by vaginal dinoprostone or misoprostol
adjustments: No renal or hepatic adjustment is given in the source opened; check product information.
monitoring: Maternal observations and progress of labour.
contraindications: Not stated in the source opened; check product information.

medicationPlan.note: NICE NG207 gives low-dose oral misoprostol 25 micrograms and mifepristone 200 mg for intrauterine fetal death. Dinoprostone and oxytocin doses are not given and follow product information and local protocol. The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) drug registration site could not be opened from this environment, so registration of each medicine was not verified; check hospital formulary.

diagnosticCriteria.criterion: Timing of induction for prolonged pregnancy
diagnosticCriteria.threshold: Offer from 41+0 weeks; labour usually starts before 42+0 weeks.
Offer dinoprostone or low-dose oral misoprostol.
Offer after 39+0 weeks with verbal consent.

patientEducation: Explain that induced labour can be more painful and pain relief options.
Explain when to contact the unit during outpatient induction.
